N23812851.raw_response: {"core_themes": "This folder contains U.S. Department of State material on a constitutional amendment promulgated in Brazil on January 23, 1963, and announced by the Department on February 14. The record includes Portuguese text and an English translation of Amendment No. 6, which revoked Amendment No. 4 (the “Ato Adicional”) and changed Article 61 of the 1946 Constitution concerning the vice president’s role in the Senado Federal.
